text:
Claire: Quick design review note from the catalog QA: when many models are compared, the version pin icon floats vertically on wrap and sometimes overlaps badges. On small widths its hard to tell which row is pinned. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/example

Omar: Repro'ed. Looks like the pin is positioned relative to content that collapses when badges wrap. Two choices: make pin a fixed right column or keep it inline and force badges into a single-line truncation with a +N overflow. Which gets priority?

Jorge: Accessibility first: fixed column wins IMO. It prevents DOM reflow from moving interactive elements and keeps keyboard focus predictable. If we use a fixed column, ensure the pin control receives a visible focus ring and has aria-pressed when active. Contrast: current pin color is low at 1px; bump to 2px outline or use a subtle bg token.

Anya: Fixed column is nicer visually but it changes horizontal space for content. If we reserve a 64px fixed column, we should make the badge column smaller: show 2 metrics inline (latency, cost) and a "+N" mini-chip that opens a popover with full metrics. Mini-chip needs aria-expanded + aria-controls. Microcopy: use "View all metrics" for the popover trigger.

Omar: Implementation note: with our virtualized list we need to avoid putting focusable elements inside cells that unmount. The fixed pin column can be outside the virtualized row but aligned, but that adds complexity for selection. Alternative: keep pin inside the row but use roving tabindex so focus doesn't break when virtualization remounts.

Jorge: Roving tabindex is good backup. Also: badges currently rely on color to convey status (good/warn). Add icons (chevron/up/down or dot) and text for screen readers. Ex: aria-label="latency: 18ms (p95), healthy". Also ensure the +N chip announces count: "+3 metrics available".

Claire: Mobile: do we collapse the badges into a single summary chip that opens a bottom sheet, or try horizontal scroll? Thumb reach matters. I'm leaning summary chip (Filters/metrics) to keep rows short.

Anya: Summary chip is safer for mobile. Also we should expose a setting for power users: "Compact rows" toggle in the catalog header (aria-pressed toggle). Compact mode uses smaller badge glyphs and hides descriptions. Add a telemetry event compact_mode_used.

Omar: For the pin label microcopy, prefer "Pin to comparison" over "Pin version"  clearer intent. Tooltip: "Pin this version so it stays in your comparison". Also add a subtle pinned state: 2px outline + small pinned badge on the left of the row.

ProductBot: Figma frame uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/.../catalog-pin-column-proposal  invites: @Anya @Jorge @Omar

Claire: Cool. Next steps: Omar to prototype fixed pin column + +N popover, Anya to update copy + a11y labels. Please drop final nits here by EOD. :rocket:
